in_marathi.name: Prakesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Creativity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prakesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Prakesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prakasha' which means 'Lord of Creativity'. This name is believed to bring creativity, innovation, and a positive outlook towards life.
